source_title: Multi-mode vortex-induced vibrations of a flexible circular cylinder
author: Francisco Javier Huera Huarte
local_pdf_filename: Huera-Huarte - 2006 - Multi-mode vortex-induced vibrations of a flexible circular cylinder.pdf
local_pdf_note: Provided by the user from Zotero; PDF intentionally not included in this Git upload.

locations.geometry: PDF p88 (printed p87), Table 4.2: D=0.028 m, L=13.12 m, Ls=5.94 m, EI=29.88 Nm^2. Although the table labels Ls 'submerged length', section 4.1 on PDF pp79-80 makes clear that 5.94 m is the lower 45% exposed to moving uniform current; the remaining upper riser was in still water inside the filled tank.
locations.dominant_frequency_extraction: PDF p109 (printed p108), section 5.4.1: dominant frequencies are peaks in spectra of dominant modal amplitudes
locations.temporal_standard_deviation: PDF p110 (printed p109), Eq 5.18: sqrt(time mean of squared deviation from time mean)
locations.spatial_then_temporal_rms: PDF p110 (printed p109), Eq 5.20: spatial mean squared dynamic displacement, then time mean and square root; used as spatial-temporal statistical template
locations.case1_reference: PDF p165 (printed p164), Table 6.1: U=0.31 m/s, Re=7622, Tt0=1175 N, ny=2, fy=1.66 Hz, nx=4, fx=3.40 Hz, mean Cd=1.86, RMS Cl=1.93
locations.case1_immersion: PDF p164 (printed p163), section 6.4: all listed cases except case 4 had water around the entire riser length
locations.case1_cl_field: PDF p165 (printed p164), section 6.4: Figure 6.8a(c) shows local Cl along riser, thick curve is its RMS, colour maps show spatiotemporal Cl
locations.mean_cd_definition: PDF p171 (printed p170), Eq 6.9-6.10: mean Cd uses total integrated mean in-line force and Ls exposed to current
locations.transverse_cl_rms_definition: PDF pp171-172 (printed pp170-171), section 6.4.2: each plotted point is transverse-force-coefficient RMS along riser model and in time, calculated by applying Eq 5.18

interpretive_scope.verified: The Cl reference is a distributed spatial-temporal statistic, not RMS of one total integrated lift coefficient.
interpretive_scope.continuous_analogue: The NM14.2 analytic spatial integral of squared piecewise-linear Cl is a continuous analogue of the thesis nodewise spatial mean; the exact discretization is different.
interpretive_scope.active_region_gap: NM14.2 direct OpenFOAM force samples only reconstruct a field over [0,5.94] m and set it to zero outside, whereas thesis Case 1 had water around the whole riser. The active-region RMS cannot be represented as strict same-domain Case-1 RMS.
interpretive_scope.experimental_force_method_gap: Thesis force field is reconstructed from measured motion and FEM; simulation force field comes from direct OpenFOAM slice forces. The two procedures are not identical.
